name: Validate variant option codes
goal: Add invariant validation to com.nexus.catalog.domain.model.VariantOption. Reject blank attributeCode or attributeValueCode, including empty and whitespace-only strings, using IllegalArgumentException. Preserve nonblank values exactly. Add focused JUnit 5 tests for valid values and for empty and whitespace-only input in each field.
acceptance_criteria: A JUnit test constructs VariantOption("code", "value") and asserts both property values with assertEquals.
A separate JUnit test constructs VariantOption(" code ", " value ") and asserts the surrounding spaces remain exactly unchanged in BOTH properties.
A JUnit test asserts IllegalArgumentException for empty attributeCode, with valid attributeValueCode.
A JUnit test asserts IllegalArgumentException for whitespace-only attributeCode, with valid attributeValueCode.
A JUnit test asserts IllegalArgumentException for empty attributeValueCode, with valid attributeCode.
A JUnit test asserts IllegalArgumentException for whitespace-only attributeValueCode, with valid attributeCode.
